name: Color Palette
description: Generate harmonious U.S.-accessible color palettes from a single color with W3C WCAG 2.2 Level AA contrast verification (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text) for ADA Title III and Section 508 compliance.
longDescription: Color Palette helps designers create beautiful, accessible color schemes for U.S. audiences. Input a base color to generate complementary, analogous, triadic, and monochromatic palettes. Contrast guidance uses W3C WCAG 2.2 Level AA ratios — 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text — applied across U.S. ADA Title III and Section 508 accessible web design. Export as CSS variables, Tailwind config, Figma JSON, Adobe ASE, and more. Save and share palettes with teams.
pricingDetails: Completely free — $0 cost versus $3/month single-purpose palette subscriptions. No account required. No usage cap.
features: Multiple harmony rules (complementary, analogous, triadic, monochromatic)
W3C WCAG 2.2 Level AA contrast checking (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text)
U.S. ADA Title III and Section 508 accessible design compliance reference
Export: CSS variables, Tailwind config, Figma JSON, Adobe ASE
Color blindness simulation and gradient generation
useCases: U.S. brand identity design with accessible color systems
UI design systems meeting ADA and Section 508 requirements
Accessibility compliance verification for U.S. public and private websites
Marketing material colors and gradient backgrounds
